tasks.title: Arts grant priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Arts grant – your ideas
paragraphs: As you know, our class is helping to decide how to spend a small community arts grant. We need to choose one main project to fund. Should we spend the money on a mural in the town centre, or on a series of free music workshops for teenagers? Which do you think is more important and why?
Also, we need to choose one practical thing to organise. Would you prefer to arrange a meeting with the town council, or create a poster to tell people about the project?
Finally, can you suggest one way to make sure the project benefits the whole community?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which project you prefer (mural or music workshops) and explain why.
Choose one thing to organise (council meeting or poster) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to make the project benefit the whole community.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the deadline for the grant application.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Community arts: your view
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town is planning to use a community arts grant for a new project. Do you think arts projects like murals or music workshops make a town a better place to live?
What is the most important thing for the organisers to consider when choosing a project?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our town website!

tasks.title: The grant decision
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator announced that the arts grant had been approved, everyone in the room started talking at once."
